title: Dabarun farashin ku, labarin ƙimar ku da kwanaki 90 na gaba
course_title: Dabarun Farashi & Ƙimar don Sabis da Aiki na Dijital

say: Dabarun farashin ku, labarin ƙimar ku, da kwanaki 90 na gaba.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 4 na Farashi da Dabarun Ƙimar.
Kun gina sassa daban-daban ta wannan darasi. Dabarar farashi tana sanya su akan shafuka ɗaya ko biyu, don haka zaku iya faɗi da sauri kuma ku bayyana kowace lamba.

Matsayin kasuwa da ƙimar tsakiya
Samfura da fakiti, tare da dalili kowane
Iyaka, canza farashin, sharuɗɗan biyan kuɗi
Manufar rangwame da kwanan wata bita na gaba
